Name: Deep Woods - Unlockable Bundles Multiplayer Compatibility Fix
Author: MrHatmann
Description:
A quick fix to allow Modded Multiplayer Games with DeepWoods and Unlockable Bundles.

Really just putting this up here for people who need it until Deep Woods updates again.

(It just makes Unlockable bundles ignore the weird way Deep Woods generates its rooms.)

I'm not sure if this will fix it in all scenarios, but it's the only way I've gotten it to work on my end for now.

Manifest.Name: Unlockable Bundles DeepWoods Fix
Manifest.Description: Prevents Unlockable Bundles from modifying DeepWoods locations.
Manifest.Author: MrHatmann
